result.title: How to build and train your recurrent-depth model: A fixed-point perspective
result.summary: Recurrent-depth models are trained with truncated backpropagation, yet it remains unclear why this works. We show that input injection, commonly used in recurrent-depth models, is exactly Halpern iteration, and that a slowly vanishing stepsize provably converges with a backpropagation window polylogarithmic in the depth. The guarantees require a Lipschitz operator, which for SwiGLU leads to a weight constraint in both row and spectral norm, while only a row norm constraint for gates. Based on these constraints, we develop an optimizer tailored to each parameter group, Sparrow, which provides a drop-in replacement of Muon/MuonH with no overhead, that speeds up training even beyond recurrent models.

AI.brief_summary: 该文从不动点视角解释循环深度模型为何可用截断反传训练：指出常用的输入注入等价于 Halpern 迭代，在 Lipschitz 算子假设下步长缓慢衰减即可用 polylog 深度窗口收敛，并据此给出按参数组施加行范数与谱范数约束的优化器 Sparrow。
AI.relevance_reason: 循环深度即重复更新同一 latent 状态，其不动点收敛与截断窗口分析可供核查 LVR 中循环式 latent 推理的训练稳定性、深度/长度泛化及状态更新是否真正收敛，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态证据。
